plan.instructions: Understand the requested change, repository boundaries, and project validation commands. Do not edit. Transition only after recording a bounded implementation plan.

implement.instructions: Implement the planned change in the isolated worktree. Keep edits scoped and run only the project validation commands allowed below.

validate_local.instructions: Run the project validation task and inspect the resulting diff. Failed or unavailable validation is not success.

audit.instructions: Review the committed diff and delivery hook definitions. Check for credential exposure, mutable deployment inputs, unsafe cleanup, missing validation, and unrelated changes. Do not edit.

APPROVED.approval_message: Local validation and review are complete. Approve project-defined preview preparation and deployment.

preview_deploy.instructions: The trusted adapter has run the project prepare and deploy tasks for the exact worktree fingerprint. Inspect the recorded action evidence; do not substitute a manual deployment.

preview_validate.instructions: The trusted adapter has run the project validation task against the deployed fingerprint. Inspect the evidence and return to implementation if it does not prove the requested behavior.

record.instructions: Record the base and final commits, validation evidence, preview disposition, unresolved risks, and manual promotion or cleanup instructions. Do not claim promotion or cleanup that did not occur.
